basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: Qualifies data for a declared purpose, version, population and time, not as a universal property.
Holds metrics, rules, observations and verdicts, while issues and remediation are linked records.
Differs from a data contract, which states expectations, while the assessment measures against them.
Allows conflicting assessments for different purposes to coexist.

may: Run declared quality rules and record measurements with method and time.
Derive a fitness verdict under the declared criteria.
Link failing checks to issues for owners.
Report trends across assessments of the same subject.
mustNot: Mutate production data or contracts to make checks pass.
Present a pass for one purpose as fitness for all purposes.
requiresHuman: Accepting known defects for a use case.

considerations: Poor quality data used in decisions about people can cause unfair outcomes.
Quality checks on personal data should use minimal samples and access.
Hiding known defects misleads data consumers.
affectedParties: People affected by decisions using the data
Data producers whose work is judged

items: An assessment names a subject version, a purpose, metrics, rules, a time window and a verdict.
Often confused with a data contract, a monitoring dashboard, a data profile or a certificate.
False pass leading to use of bad data.
Outdated verdict applied to a newer data version.
